Kronsoft is hiring
QA Automation Engineer.
Who is the key person who ensures us that the product software is developed to high-quality standards, offering the performance and stability desired by the customer? Obviously, we have only one expert in our team – the QA Automation Engineer
 Requirements
 It might be you who we are looking for, if you have
Relevant hands-on experience in automation testing
The ability to learn and understand the business logic of the product;
The capability to properly analyze written documentation/ specifications
The capacity of tracing the best approach to test various functionalities, using the most appropriate testing techniques for specific use-cases, thus reaching an optimal coverage.
Identifying defects/ inconsistencies and defining clear and relevant test scenarios/ test-cases to ensure the application’s compliance with the given acceptance criteria.
Create/ review/ update test-cases based on the functional and non-functional requirements.
Significance level of the discovered issues
The capacity to observe unanticipated problems and to avoid critical issues.
The skill of conducting a risk assessment on the newly implemented feature, in order to prevent major impacts on the overall application.
Assuming the responsibility of the tested product, by ensuring that the system follows the provided requirements;
Time productivity – meeting the deadlines along the application life cycle, up to production.
Ability to communicate outside of the testing team boundaries: Product management, Product owner, Development team, Support team.
Knowledge of automation testing tools, scripting and programming: Cypress, Java, Python, Bash
Experience in functional and non-functional testing
 Responsibilities
 If you join us, you will have to
Designing and implementing testing processes, executing test cases, identifying defects and collaborating with developers to improve the quality of the application
Identifying defects/ inconsistencies and defining clear and relevant test scenarios/ test-cases to ensure the application’s compliance with the given acceptance criteria.
Create/ review/ update test-cases based on the functional and non-functional requirements.
Reporting and monitoring issues
Analyzing business and technical requirements
Performing a wide range of tests: Regression, Functional, Non-functional, Exploratory, Integration;
Documentation of defects/ bugs and follow up on the resolution.
Collaborating closely with the developers and Technical Leaders in order to identify and solve all the defects and bugs
Working and staying up-to-date with the latest testing tools
 What’s in it for you?
You will to be involved in challenging projects and you will have the opportunity to develop yourself in a key and stable domain like pharma&healthcare with major impact on people’s lives.
As career path you will have the chance to grow professionally, developing and enriching your technical and soft skills, by working with the latest technologies, performing complex tasks and dealing with challenging customers.
Access to meaningful courses, conferences and technical trainings.
A special culture and spirit based on: transparency, flexibility, new technologies, team spirit
Attractive salary package and benefits.
